mappings.note: Padyansh on the first pad with five sub-questions: four are close reading of Krishna's plea (LO-147) and Q4 asks the meaning of 'barbas' (LO-150). Both cited so neither half is left unmapped. NB the printed extract has 'madhulan' for 'Madhuban' and a stray apostrophe before 'chaar pahar'.

Padyansh on the second pad: sub-questions on what Surdas depicts and who embraced Krishna (LO-147), plus glosses of 'lakuti kamariya', 'patiyayo' and 'man ki ati bhori' (LO-150). NB the sub-question numbering is broken - there are two Q3s and no Q5 - though five answers are keyed.
